s: Today's episode is a little different.
We are going to review the words we learned in our last three lessons.
Three days, three topics: pets, work, and sports.
Let's start with day one: pets and animals.
Maya, you have a dog, right?
Every morning I take his leash and we walk to the park.
A leash is a strong strap you hold when you walk a dog.
To fetch means to go and bring something back.
I throw a ball, and Max runs to fetch it.
We play fetch every morning in the park.
Where does he sleep at night?
A kennel is a small house where a dog sleeps.
His kennel is in the living room.
Hey, before we talk about my cat, let me tell you about the Muse English app.
If you enjoy this podcast, you'll love the app.
Every day you get new words with real photos and clear pronunciation audio.
You can listen to this podcast, practice with shadowing stories, take quizzes, and learn grammar step by step.
You earn points and climb the leaderboard as you learn.
It's free to install, so open your app store today and start learning English with Muse!
Now tell me about your cat, Lena.
Last month I found a stray near my house.
A stray is an animal that is lost and has no home.
Now every evening she sits on my lap and begins to purr.
To purr is the soft sound a cat makes when it is happy.
A cat will purr when you pet it gently.
To groom means to clean and brush an animal's hair.
Yes, I groom her twice a week.
I groom her with a small soft brush.
That's why I bought a scratching post.
A scratching post is a post that cats use to scratch their claws.
So from our pets day we have: leash, fetch, kennel, stray, purr, groom, and scratching post.
Day two was all about work and careers.
Maya, let's talk about your job first.
An employee is a person who works for a company.
I am an employee at a small design company.
Every employee in our office gets free coffee.
What is the biggest benefit of your job?
A benefit is something good you get from a job, like free lunch or extra days off.
The biggest benefit of my job is free lunch.
Another great benefit is working from home two days a week.
Now, a paycheck is the money you receive for your work.
When did you get your first paycheck?
I saved half of my first paycheck.
To freelance means to work for yourself, doing short jobs for different companies.
The freedom is the biggest benefit of freelance work.
Did you need training to become a writer?
Training is learning the skills you need for a job.
Yes, I did a lot of training.
New employees get two weeks of training at most companies.
A career is the series of jobs you do in your life.
I started my career as an assistant.
I started my career as a teacher.
Last week I had to write a report about a big project.
A report is a written document about work that has been done.
I wrote the report in three days.
After I finished that report, my boss loved the report and gave me more freelance work!
So day two gave us: employee, benefit, paycheck, freelance, training, career, and report.
And speaking of learning, here's a quick word about the Muse English app.
It's the perfect partner for this podcast.
You get daily vocabulary with photos, pronunciation practice with every word, fun shadowing stories to train your speaking, short quizzes to test yourself, and clear grammar lessons.
Your points build up on the leaderboard and keep you motivated.
Download it free today and make English part of your daily routine!
To do exercise means to do physical activity to stay healthy.
When I do exercise, I feel strong all day.
Everyone should do exercise at least three times a week.
I go to the gym three times a week.
A gym is a place for exercise and sports.
My gym opens at six in the morning.
I don't go to the gym.
We often go swimming on Saturdays.
In summer, we go swimming in the lake near my house.
I love to go swimming with my friends.
Ice hockey is a sport played on ice with sticks and a puck.
He plays ice hockey every winter.
I have never tried ice hockey.
A footballer is a person who plays football.
And one cricket word: a century is a score of one hundred runs in cricket.
My friend scored a century in a school match.
The most important rule in sports: never give up.
To give up means to stop trying.
Don't give up on your dreams.
When training is hard, don't give up.
When you want to give up, remember why you started, and never give up!
So day three: do exercise, gym, go swimming, ice hockey, footballer, century, and give up.
Let's do a fast final review.
I will say a word, and you say what it means.
Something good you get from a job!
To go and bring something back!
The soft sound a happy cat makes!
Learning the skills you need for a job!
To stop trying, but we never do!
A sport on ice with sticks and a puck!
To clean and brush an animal's hair!
Listeners, how many did you remember?
Keep practicing, and join us tomorrow for new words on Muse English!
